name: bilingual_book_maker
setup: . scripts/env.sh && mkdir -p "$ENV/tiktoken" "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" "$ENV/cache" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$ENV/cache" TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/tiktoken" "$ENV/bin/python" -c "import tiktoken; tiktoken.get_encoding('cl100k_base')"
test_cmd: unset OPENAI_API_KEY ANTHROPIC_API_KEY BBM_API_KEY GEMINI_API_KEY JEV_API_KEY; mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" "$ENV/cache" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$ENV/cache" TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR="$ENV/tiktoken" $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider
notes: CI (.github/workflows/make_test_ebook.yaml, job `testing`) does `pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install . && pytest -q` on Python 3.10. Here it's Python 3.12.15 (uv; black targets py312, requires-python >=3.10), the hash-pinned requirements.txt (openai 2.30.0, anthropic 0.89.0, google-genai 2.22.0, tiktoken 0.12.0), then the package editable from $SRC plus pytest 9.1.1. test_cmd is the CI's bare `pytest -q` from the repo root. pyproject addopts already deselects the corpus, live_provider and pdf_route_ci markers (51 deselected), so nothing is deselected by hand. The CLI contract tests run make_book.py subprocesses against an in-repo hermetic stand-in (tests/hermetic/sitecustomize.py) or a 127.0.0.1 fake OpenAI server. Offline fix: book_maker/utils.py num_tokens_from_text calls tiktoken, which downloads cl100k_base from openaipublic.blob.core.windows.net on first use. With the network denied, 134 tests failed on that download (test_cli, test_translation_plan, test_general_grouping_and_json_degree, test_prompt_capture_server, test_flag_compat, test_plan_auto, ...). So setup step 4 pre-fetches the encoding into $ENV/tiktoken, and test_cmd points TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR there. After that, the suite passes with outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed). The 387 skips are environmental and the same every run: 183 need Pandoc, 24+1+1 pypdfium2, 13 docling, 5 docling_core, 4 PIL, 1 reportlab (the optional `pdf` extra is not installed, as in the CI base job), 7 epubcheck jar, 7 local-only fixture gilgamesh.epub, and 2 local-only review docs. HOME, TMPDIR and XDG_CACHE_HOME are sandboxed into $ENV, and provider key variables are unset in test_cmd. RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY was unset for every run. Three runs gave identical counts, 2993 passed / 387 skipped / 3 xfailed / 0 failed, exit 0 (392s and 453s with TIKTOKEN_CACHE_DIR but without XDG_CACHE_HOME/unset; 325s with the exact test_cmd above). Wall time varies a lot (5-8 min), hence timeout_s 1500.
